clinic.name: Ascent Family Dentistry
clinic.tagline: Where many have found their Minnesota smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Warm Welcome & Assessment
treatmentJourney.description: Begin your journey with a caring, professional greeting followed by a detailed and thorough examination of your current oral health status.

treatmentJourney.title: Personalized Care Planning
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Heinlein and his staff develop a custom treatment plan focused on building trust, loyalty, and your perfect smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Preventive Hygiene Care
treatmentJourney.description: Our hygienists use the latest research on periodontal disease to provide detailed cleanings that improve your overall health.

treatmentJourney.title: Advanced Restorative Treatment
treatmentJourney.description: Using modern technology and techniques, we perform necessary restorative care such as fillings or root canals with incomparable quality.

treatmentJourney.title: Aesthetic & Specialty Care
treatmentJourney.description: Enhance your smile with options like clear aligner therapy or dental implants to restore full function and confidence.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Maintenance
treatmentJourney.description: We provide ongoing support through our Oral Health Plan to ensure your results last and your oral hygiene remains excellent.

doctor.name: Taylor Heinlein
doctor.bio: Dr. Taylor Heinlein received his Doctor of Dental Surgery degree with honors from the University of Minnesota. A lifelong learner and member of the Academy of General Dentistry, he loves incorporating the newest technology to better treat patients, including implant placement and clear aligner therapy. He is dedicated to providing caring, professional, and incomparable quality care. Dr. Heinlein credits his early love for science to his 5th grade teacher and is committed to helping others through healthcare.

reviews.name: Michael R.
reviews.text: Dr. Heinlein is professional and caring. The clinic is first class and they really take pride in making your visit a pleasant experience.

reviews.name: Jennifer L.
reviews.text: The hygienists here are so detailed and thorough. They use the latest research to help with my periodontal health and overall wellness.

reviews.name: David K.
reviews.text: I came in for dental implants and was impressed by the modern technology and techniques used. This is a practice built on reputation.
